## 1. Registration Flow

New users create an account to start paper trading.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    REGISTRATION FLOW                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                          │
│  1. User navigates to /login                             │
│                    │                                     │
│  2. Clicks "Sign Up" tab                                │
│                    │                                     │
│  3. Enters Email + Password                             │
│     └─ Password validation: min 8 chars, strength check │
│                    │                                     │
│  4. Clicks "Register"                                   │
│                    │                                     │
│  5. Backend validates input                             │
│     ├─ Check email format                               │
│     ├─ Check password strength                          │
│     └─ Check email uniqueness in database               │
│                    │                                     │
│  6. Create user record in PostgreSQL                    │
│     ├─ Hash password (bcrypt)                           │
│     ├─ Assign FREE tier                                 │
│     ├─ Set virtual capital: ₹1,00,000                   │
│     └─ Create portfolio record                          │
│                    │                                     │
│  7. Generate JWT token (7-day expiry)                   │
│                    │                                     │
│  8. Return JWT to client                                │
│                    │                                     │
│  9. Store token (localStorage)                          │
│                    │                                     │
│  10. Redirect to /dashboard                             │
│      └─ User is on FREE tier                            │
│                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Registration Error Cases

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Duplicate email | Return 409 Conflict — "Email already registered" |
| Weak password | Return 400 Bad Request — "Password must be at least 8 characters" |
| Invalid email format | Return 400 Bad Request — "Invalid email format" |
| Server error | Return 500 — Show generic error message |

## 2. Login Flow

Returning users authenticate with credentials or Google OAuth.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      LOGIN FLOW                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                          │
│  1. User navigates to /login                             │
│                    │                                     │
│  2. Selects login method:                               │
│     ├─ Email + Password                                 │
│     └─ Google OAuth (see Section 3)                     │
│                    │                                     │
│  3. Enters Email + Password                             │
│                    │                                     │
│  4. POST /api/auth/login                                │
│     ├─ Find user by email                               │
│     ├─ Compare password hash (bcrypt)                   │
│     └─ Verify account is active                         │
│                    │                                     │
│  5. Generate JWT token                                  │
│     ├─ Payload: { userId, email, role, tier }           │
│     ├─ Signed with JWT_SECRET                           │
│     └─ Expiry: JWT_EXPIRES_IN (default: 7d)            │
│                    │                                     │
│  6. Return JWT + user profile to client                 │
│                    │                                     │
│  7. Client stores JWT in localStorage                   │
│                    │                                     │
│  8. Initialize WebSocket connection                     │
│     └─ Connect to NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL                    │
│                    │                                     │
│  9. Redirect to /dashboard                              │
│                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Login Error Cases

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| User not found | Return 404 — "No account found with this email" |
| Wrong password | Return 401 — "Invalid credentials" |
| Account disabled | Return 403 — "Account has been disabled" |

## 3. Google OAuth Flow

Users can authenticate using their Google account.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   GOOGLE OAUTH FLOW                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                              │
│  1. User clicks "Continue with Google" on login page         │
│                        │                                     │
│  2. Client calls GET /api/auth/google                        │
│     └─ Server constructs Google OAuth URL with:              │
│        ├─ client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID                        │
│        ├─ redirect_uri: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI                  │
│        ├─ scope: openid email profile                        │
│        └─ response_type: code                                │
│                        │                                     │
│  3. Browser redirects to Google's consent screen            │
│     └─ User selects Google account and grants permission     │
│                        │                                     │
│  4. Google redirects back to:                                │
│     GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI?code={auth_code}                     │
│                        │                                     │
│  5. GET /api/auth/google/callback?code={auth_code}          │
│     ├─ Exchange auth_code for tokens (Google API)            │
│     │   POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token             │
│     │   Body: code, client_id, client_secret,                │
│     │         redirect_uri, grant_type=authorization_code    │
│     ├─ Decode id_token to get user profile                   │
│     │   ├─ Google user ID                                    │
│     │   ├─ Email                                             │
│     │   └─ Name / Avatar                                     │
│     └─ Find or create user in database                       │
│         ├─ If user exists: update Google ID, login           │
│         └─ If new user: create account with FREE tier,       │
│            ₹1,00,000 virtual capital                         │
│                        │                                     │
│  6. Generate JWT token for session                           │
│                        │                                     │
│  7. Redirect to /dashboard?token={jwt}                       │
│     └─ Client stores token from URL params                   │
│                        │                                     │
│  8. Initialize WebSocket connection                          │
│                        │                                     │
│  9. User is logged in and on dashboard                       │
│                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Google OAuth Error Cases

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| User denies permission | Google redirects with `error=access_denied` — show login page |
| Invalid auth code | Return 400 — "Invalid authorization code" |
| Token exchange fails | Return 502 — "Failed to authenticate with Google" |
| `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI` mismatch | Google shows error — URIs must match exactly |

## 4. Trade Placement Flow

Users place orders to buy or sell instruments.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  TRADE PLACEMENT FLOW                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                              │
│  1. User browses stocks/futures/options on respective pages │
│                        │                                     │
│  2. Clicks on a stock/derivative to open detail view        │
│                        │                                     │
│  3. Trade panel opens (BUY/SELL toggle)                      │
│                        │                                     │
│  4. User configures order:                                   │
│     ├─ Side: BUY or SELL                                    │
│     ├─ Order Type: MARKET / LIMIT / SL                      │
│     ├─ Quantity: Number of shares/lots                      │
│     ├─ Price: (for LIMIT/SL orders)                         │
│     ├─ Stop Loss: Trigger price for auto-exit              │
│     └─ Target: Profit target for auto-exit                 │
│                        │                                     │
│  5. Client-side validation:                                  │
│     ├─ Quantity > 0                                          │
│     ├─ Sufficient virtual balance/margin                    │
│     ├─ Price > 0 (for LIMIT orders)                         │
│     ├─ SL < current price (for BUY) or SL > current (SELL) │
│     ├─ Target > current price (for BUY) or Target < (SELL) │
│     └─ Premium tier check (futures/options require PREMIUM)│
│                        │                                     │
│  6. POST /api/trade/order                                    │
│     ├─ Verify JWT authentication                            │
│     ├─ Re-validate all inputs server-side                   │
│     ├─ Check market hours (if ENFORCE_MARKET_HOURS=true)   │
│     ├─ Calculate brokerage (BROKERAGE_PERCENT)              │
│     ├─ Check margin requirements (futures)                  │
│     ├─ Create Order record in database                      │
│     │   ├─ status: OPEN / FILLED / PENDING                  │
│     │   ├─ type: MARKET / LIMIT / SL                        │
│     │   └─ segment: EQUITY / FUTURES / OPTIONS              │
│     └─ Create/Update Position record                        │
│                        │                                     │
│  7. For MARKET orders:                                      │
│     ├─ Fill immediately at current market price             │
│     └─ Create Trade record (execution log)                  │
│                                                              │
│  8. For LIMIT/SL orders:                                    │
│     └─ Status remains PENDING until price condition met     │
│                        │                                     │
│  9. Return order confirmation to client                      │
│     ├─ Order ID                                             │
│     ├─ Fill price                                           │
│     ├─ Brokerage charged                                    │
│     └─ Updated available balance                            │
│                        │                                     │
│  10. UI updates:                                             │
│      ├─ Order appears in Orders page                        │
│      ├─ Position opens/appears in Positions page            │
│      ├─ Portfolio value updates                             │
│      └─ If SL/Target set: GlobalSLMonitor begins tracking   │
│                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 5. Auto-Exit Flow

The `GlobalSLMonitor` component watches open positions and auto-squares them when SL or Target prices are hit.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    AUTO-EXIT FLOW                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                              │
│  1. User has open positions with SL and/or Target set       │
│                        │                                     │
│  2. GlobalSLMonitor component initializes on app load       │
│     └─ Fetches all open positions with SL/Target from API  │
│                        │                                     │
│  3. WebSocket connection streams real-time prices           │
│     ├─ Yahoo Finance polling (fallback)                     │
│     └─ Upstox API WebSocket (primary, real-time)            │
│                        │                                     │
│  4. For each price update:                                  │
│     ├─ Match price to symbol in monitored positions         │
│     └─ For each matching position:                          │
│         ├─ If BUY position:                                 │
│         │   ├─ Check: current_price <= stop_loss → SL HIT   │
│         │   └─ Check: current_price >= target → TARGET HIT  │
│         └─ If SELL position:                                │
│             ├─ Check: current_price >= stop_loss → SL HIT   │
│             └─ Check: current_price <= target → TARGET HIT  │
│                        │                                     │
│  5. When SL or Target is hit:                               │
│     ├─ POST /api/trade/square-off                           │
│     │   ├─ Position ID                                      │
│     │   ├─ Current market price (trigger price)             │
│     │   └─ Reason: "STOP_LOSS" or "TARGET"                 │
│     ├─ Server closes position                               │
│     │   ├─ Calculate final P&L                              │
│     │   ├─ Deduct brokerage                                 │
│     │   ├─ Update portfolio balance                         │
│     │   └─ Create Trade record (exit execution)            │
│     └─ Return confirmation                                  │
│                        │                                     │
│  6. Client updates:                                          │
│     ├─ Remove from monitored positions                      │
│     ├─ Update Positions page (position closed)              │
│     ├─ Update Portfolio (realized P&L)                      │
│     └─ Show notification: "SL hit on RELIANCE — Loss ₹XXX"  │
│         or "Target hit on TCS — Profit ₹XXX"                │
│                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Auto-Exit Edge Cases

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| WebSocket disconnects | Reconnect and resume monitoring; check for missed triggers on reconnect |
| Market closes with open SL/Target | Monitoring pauses; resumes on next market open |
| SL = Target (same price) | Both conditions trigger simultaneously — position closed |
| Partial fill (not applicable — paper trading) | Always full fill in paper trading |
| Multiple positions same symbol | Each position monitored independently |

## 6. Order Types

| Order Type | Description | Price Behavior |
|-----------|-------------|----------------|
| **MARKET** | Executes immediately at the current market price | Uses latest available price from WebSocket/REST |
| **LIMIT** | Executes only when market price reaches the specified limit price | BUY: triggers when price ≤ limit; SELL: triggers when price ≥ limit |
| **SL (Stop Loss)** | Placed as a pending order; triggers when price crosses the stop price | BUY-SL: triggers when price ≥ stop; SELL-SL: triggers when price ≤ stop |

### Order Lifecycle

```
PLACED → PENDING → TRIGGERED → FILLED → EXECUTED
                    ↓
                 EXPIRED (if not triggered within validity)
                    ↓
                 CANCELLED (user manually cancels)
```

---

## 7. Trading Segments

### 7.1 Equity (Cash Market)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Segment Code | `EQUITY` |
| Instruments | NSE-listed stocks (RELIANCE, TCS, INFY, HDFC BANK, etc.) |
| Lot Size | 1 share (no lot restriction) |
| Margin Required | Full order value (no leverage) |
| Brokerage | BROKERAGE_PERCENT of order value (min: MIN_BROKERAGE, max: MAX_BROKERAGE) |
| Tier | FREE and PREMIUM |

### 7.2 Futures

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Segment Code | `FUTURES` |
| Instruments | NSE futures contracts (monthly expiry) |
| Lot Size | Varies by instrument (e.g., NIFTY: 25 lots, RELIANCE: 250) |
| Margin Required | DEFAULT_FUTURES_MARGIN_PERCENT of contract value |
| Brokerage | BROKERAGE_PERCENT of notional value |
| Tier | **PREMIUM only** |

### 7.3 Options (CE/PE)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Segment Code | `OPTIONS` |
| Instruments | NSE options (Calls/CE and Puts/PE, weekly/monthly expiry) |
| Lot Size | Varies by instrument (e.g., NIFTY: 25, BANKNIFTY: 15) |
| Premium | Current market premium price × lot size |
| Margin Required | Premium paid (for buyers) |
| Brokerage | BROKERAGE_PERCENT of premium value |
| Tier | **PREMIUM only** |

### Option Types

| Type | Code | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Call Option** | CE | Right to buy at strike price. Profit increases as underlying rises. |
| **Put Option** | PE | Right to sell at strike price. Profit increases as underlying falls. |

---

## Quick Reference: Full Trade Lifecycle

```
Browse → Select → Configure → Validate → Submit → Fill → Position Open
                                                           │
                                                    SL/Target Monitoring
                                                           │
                                                    ┌──────┴──────┐
                                                 SL Hit      Target Hit
                                                    │              │
                                                 Auto-Square   Auto-Square
                                                    │              │
                                              P&L Realized   P&L Realized
                                                    │              │
                                              Position Closed Position Closed
                                                    └──────┬───────┘
                                                           │
                                                    Notification Sent
                                                    Portfolio Updated
```
